gotchas: The RS-485 port can be TURNED OFF from the front panel. The G3 manual: 'The RS485 communication port supports 5V output and communication function when enabled. And it has no output and communication function when disabled.' Set via PV parameters → hold for 5 s → CON → EN/DIS. A G3 that answers nothing may simply be se

Primary / Secondary mode. 'The Primary mode is used for BMS communication; the Secondary mode is used for RS485 communication.' Set at the same CON menu, nnS interface: 'nn' = primary, 'S' = secondary. A unit left in Primary mode is talking to a battery BMS, not listening for a gateway.

Models with PV open-circuit voltage ≤ 60 V have a NON-ISOLATED RS-485 interface; only models rated ≥ 100 V Voc are isolated and may be connected directly. This flips the isolation assumption depending on which G3 you bought.
The G3's remote meter is the MT52, not the MT50. The XTRA-N G3 manual names MT52 throughout.
'XDS2' in a retail title is the display unit (advanced LCD), not a protocol variant. XTRA-N controllers ship with XDB1, XDS1 or XDS2 displays on the same hardware.
